name: GoofyOofer
summary: GoofyOofer is a Multiplayer Horror VR Game where you play as a Chimp and can only move with your hands with NO LEGS!! You also have lots of opportunities like exploring a cave with monsters inside and going deeper inside down to a secret lab with more monsters, you can also play TAG with other Chimps! or just be in a casual game mode with other chimps. You can also go shopping and get new Clothes and Hats and More! Welcome to GoofyOofer! Play now for free.
